headline: Elon Musk's $446 Million Midterm Bet Fails
standfirst: The tech billionaire poured massive funds into Republican groups, but saw little return.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Elon Musk spent $446 million on Republican groups. Yet, Democrats won every Senate race he targeted.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The tech industry spent heavily on the midterms. It was an attempt to influence election outcomes.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Huge political spending does not guarantee results. This shows money cannot always buy elections.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for future tech industry spending patterns. We will see if donors change their strategies.

caption:
Elon Musk spent over 400 million dollars on US midterm elections but saw limited success for his investments.

Despite record-breaking spending from the tech sector, the results were underwhelming. Democrats swept the five key Senate races where Musk's money was most active. It highlights the limits of political influence through direct funding.

Do you think big money in politics actually changes how people vote?
